description: Reopen r-sort-3b-nulls (General) read-only. Seek with each of = >= > <= < and the keys Null, empty and a on index IX of NI1, NI2, NI5, NI6 and NR1; and Seek =, >= and <= with the compound keys (Null, Null), (Null, 1), (Null), (empty, Null), (empty, 1), (a, Null), (a, 2) and (a) on NI3, NI4 and NR3; reading NoMatch and the ID of the current record after each. Asks whether a Null or empty key finds a row through an IGNORE NULL index, and how partial and Null compound keys select under it compared with the plain index.
